item.summary: fix(compaction): summarize the prepared window and always restore audited identifiers (#129423) * fix(compaction): restore omitted source identifiers * fix: log ChatGPT stream termination reasons * fix(compaction): summarize the prepared window and always restore audited identifiers Two safeguard defects made auto-compaction fail closed on tool-heavy sessions: 1. When the prepared window held only tool calls/results, the safeguard replaced it with sessionManager.getBranch() — the whole branch from root. Since #112988 made /new a reset entry inside the same transcript, that branch spans every reset and prior compaction (3,565 messages / 5.2 MB on the reporting session), so one compaction became dozens of sequential model calls until the 900s watchdog fired ("Compaction timed out"). The #78390 reason for that fallback (preparation omitting custom messages) is handled by core projectSessionEntryMessage now. Summarize only the prepared window; decide "nothing to summarize" from the boundary-scoped context (buildSessionContext), never the raw branch. Delete the fallback and its sessions_send replay sanitizers, which only existed for it. 2. #122824 moved the identifier oracle to the mess
